name: com.mjgame.nmd.nkl.20
description: MJGame is a package developed by nmd.nkl to enhance Unity game development, particularly for 2D games. It includes a collection of essential, reusable code snippets designed to accelerate workflows and simplify the development process.

release.notes: Added new samples and updated dependencies.
newFeatures: Added Data management for player data in the game
Added RemoveMissingScripts feature to clean up missing scripts in the scene
Updated MJGameEditor with new features and improvements
Added UI interface to view saved player data in samples

samples.description: An example demonstrating the use of object pooling to efficiently manage resources and optimize game performance.
An example showcasing the implementation of a State Machine for streamlined game logic management.
An example illustrating advanced techniques for creating and managing user interfaces in Unity.
A comprehensive example showcasing advanced methods for designing and handling user interfaces in Unity, with a focus on data management and interactive elements.
ViewPlayerPrefs is a simple tool that allows you to view and edit PlayerPrefs in Unity Editor.
